_comment: Moderation tuning. Every value here changes behaviour without a code edit.
See DECISIONS.md, Decisions 10-15. The model never reads this file: no LLM call is
in the path of a mod action (Decision 12).
A warn or an AutoMod block is one strike. Strikes count inside windowHours.
When the count reaches a step's `at`, Johnny applies that timeout. Above the top step,
each new strike applies the top step again. Timeouts only: Johnny never kicks or bans
on his own (Decision 14). An empty ladder turns escalation off.
What /automod setup puts on Discord. Each rule is Discord's own AutoMod rule, so it
keeps working when Johnny is offline (Decision 13). Johnny only edits rules whose name
starts with rulePrefix. Presets: profanity, sexual_content, slurs.
Limits per server (Discord): 6 keyword rules, 1 spam, 1 preset, 1 mention-spam.
blockMessage is shown to the member (150 characters at most).
automod.blockMessage: Blocked by AutoMod. That message breaks a rule on this server.
